decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposed storage building due to its position, size and scale would not harm neighbours' living conditions and the character and appearance of the area, in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and E.2.1 (Environmental Criteria) of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 8am to 12pm  on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

(Reason.  In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties)
(a) ENV.B.1.1 New development
(b) ENV.P.1.5 Noise pollution)
Condition : 5 - The building hereby approved shall have a maximum width of 5.5m and a depth of 12.05m.

Condition : 6 - The building hereby approved shall only be used for storage purposes ancillary to No.206 Great West Road and shall not be used separately for residential, retail, business, office or industrial use, or for vehicle parking.REASON:  The Council is satisfied that the use hereby approved would not result in detriment to adjoining properties but would wish to control future changes of use in the interests of adjoining neighbours' living conditions.

Condition : 7 - Informative:
Please note that dimension of the depth of the building on the side elevation drawing, the floor plan and site plan do not correspond with each other.  The width of the building as shown on the floor plan and rear elevational drawing does not correspond with the width shown on the site plan.  Permission has therefore been granted on the basis of the width of the building being 5.5m as shown on drawing CN/GTWSTRD/01, and the depth being 12.05m scaled from drawing CN/GTWSTRD/01.
description: Erection of a detached single storey storage building ancillary to 206 Great West Road
